macros.name: termindent
macros.doc: The amount of the left indentation of each term is defined by the macro \termindent.

macros.name: termlabel
macros.doc: The label of each term is defined by the macro \termlabel.

macros.name: termlabelfont
macros.doc: The termlabelfont macro defines the font and color of the label of each term inside the termlist and term environments.
